profile: shared stand renderer and engine; portable local SessionPort/IndexedDB; no MASTER
changes: Upgrade from stale Oct 5 snapshot to verified installed Oct 7 renderer and authoritative task-clock core; 247 original build inputs verified
Future icons remain unmounted until native handoff; completed task vector checks retained
Native 60-second task timer restored; measured responsive browser composition; original physical wall profile retained
KDW channel keyboard overlay and persistent editable store retained
Device bezel uses nine-slice geometry to preserve authored corner radius and light padding during viewport resize and retained phone/PC morphs; R9 contentRevision and player progress preserved

Preplan one browser scene envelope per mission from all catalog screens, admitted icon counts and full instruction; no fit/configure/GPU resize on copy reveal, device morph or task handoff; R9 progress retained

One catalog-wide browser scale shared by menu and all four missions; icon/icon and icon/device route gaps doubled from 64 to 128 logical px; accumulated route history may extend off the left edge without zooming or shifting the device

Portable browser links use fixed facing side ports, 54% fan span, bounded 6 logical px critically damped bend and gentler fiber waves; resize cannot swing attachment angles around corners; wall profile unchanged

Automatic portable route consumes the same interpolated horizontal layout as device morph in each renderer prepare; remove secondary icon X spring to prevent transient overlap; retain authored paths, vertical drift, manual gestures and wall profile
Portable device fan and icon-to-icon connections share the same routeLinkStyle: identical strand width, spacing, gradient, waves and particles; only fan geometry differs

Apply six reviewed Figma copy changes with guarded baseline, rename business.platform to Registration; native store help reads the authoritative snapshot; preserve gameplay revision and saved progress

Native store HTML follows the existing WebGL phone, route and common projection; preserve timer, links and instruction. Curved 680ms product flights with 360ms landing feedback track live slot rectangles; concurrent input, resize, cancellation and reduced motion supported; existing R9 saved selections preserved.

Business registration starts with a native vector choice of cafe, hotel or theater; ACT persists businessType before the existing login, retaining task timer and common scale. Strict historical receipt replay preserves pre-choice R9 saves; new starts and restarts use the new first screen.

Replace three static histogram peaks with a broad curved travelling light ramp over the pixel lattice; stronger independent 8/16-second gradient orbits and colour drift on the existing bounded GPU clock. Foreground geometry and saved gameplay are unchanged.

Correct the background to a true moving circular ramp in pixel coordinates. The same per-cell ramp controls both square half-size and emission; dark cells shrink to zero. Profile-scoped composite SDF replaces the fixed-size stamp and disables its mismatched fixed-size halo. Preserve dynamic gradient and the existing shared clock.

Use the unchanged installed native standby renderer: TV loop, MAX logo and four first-task glyphs. Local SELECT_MISSION uses the authoritative session, resumed tasks enter directly, one 4096px composition envelope prevents scale jumps; no default developer or alternate touch menu.
excluded: Visitor data, databases, credentials, deployment configuration
